note: Fastest of three runs, milliseconds, recorded on the CI runner (ubuntu-latest) where the gate actually runs. The check fails at a factor of 2, not at a percentage, because that is the difference between a real regression and scheduler noise. A workstation is expected to be slower than this; the factor is what absorbs that, which is why the baseline is the runner and not the author's machine. Re-record with `node scripts/perf-check.mjs --write` after a deliberate change, and update README.md to match.
